signature: SUBROUTINE DLAMSWLQ( SIDE, TRANS, M, N, K, MB, NB, A, LDA, T, LDT, C, LDC, WORK, LWORK, INFO )

params.name: side
params.reference:
-   `= 'L'`: apply Q or $Q^T$ from the Left;
-   `= 'R'`: apply Q or $Q^T$ from the Right.

params.name: trans
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: No transpose, apply Q;
-   `= 'T'`: Transpose, apply $Q^T$.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix C. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix C. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: K
params.reference: The number of elementary reflectors whose product defines the matrix Q. $M \ge K \ge 0$;

params.name: mb
params.reference: The row block size to be used in the blocked LQ. $M \ge \mathrm{MB} \ge 1$

params.name: nb
params.reference: The column block size to be used in the blocked LQ. $\mathrm{NB} > M$.

params.name: A
params.reference: (`LDA`,N) if `SIDE = 'R'` The i-th row must contain the vector which defines the blocked elementary reflector H(i), for $i = 1$,2,...,k, as returned by DLASWLQ in the first k rows of its array argument A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,K)$.

params.name: ldt
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array T. $\mathrm{LDT} \ge \mathrm{MB}$.

params.name: C
params.reference: On entry, the M-by-N matrix C. On exit, C is overwritten by $Q \, C$ or $Q^T \, C$ or $C \, Q^T$ or $C \, Q$.

params.name: ldc
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array C. $\mathrm{LDC} \ge \max (1,M)$.

minLength.js: max( 1, side === 'left' ? N * mb : M * mb )

params.name: lwork
params.reference: The dimension of the array `WORK`. If `SIDE = 'L'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,\mathrm{NB}) \, \mathrm{MB}$; if `SIDE = 'R'`, $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge \max (1,M) \, \mathrm{MB}$. If `LWORK = -1`, then a workspace query is assumed; the routine only calculates the optimal size of the `WORK` array, returns this value as the first entry of the `WORK` array, and no error message related to `LWORK` is issued by XERBLA.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value

quickReturn.js: nb <= K || nb >= max( max( M, N ), K )
sets: CALL DGEMLQT( SIDE, TRANS, M, N, K, MB, A, LDA, T, LDT, C, LDC, WORK, INFO)
